subject.title: feat(agents): add description field for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should authorized `agents_list` callers receive configured nonblank `agents.list[].description` values as model-visible discovery metadata?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and proven, but whether operator-authored configuration text may cross into model context is a durable security and product contract that cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Accept the bounded metadata contract
options.body: Merge after confirming that descriptions are intentionally model-visible to authorized discovery callers and should exclude secrets or sensitive internal details.

options.title: Narrow or reject exposure
options.body: Keep descriptions configuration-only, or define a separate explicitly safe discovery field, if current descriptions may contain information that must not enter model context.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded metadata contract
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming that descriptions are intentionally model-visible to authorized discovery callers and should exclude secrets or sensitive internal details.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged adjacent work owns the current preservation semantics for authored agent-description metadata, making them the strongest available routing candidate for its visibility boundary.
